how_it_works: Document failures factually (what happened, conditions, consequences) without blame, and mine them for design lessons. Blame cultures hide failures; learning cultures harvest them.
key_points: Failures are expensive experiments - harvest the data.

description: Symptoms are what you see; root causes are why it happened. Fixing symptoms guarantees recurrence; fixing roots prevents it. The distinction is the whole discipline.

key_points: Test: does the fix prevent recurrence?
